compiled_state.title: Write failing integration tests for PR-merge mode dispatcher and enforcement hook gating
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: A suite of failing (RED) integration tests covering the PR-merge mode dispatcher, enforcement hook gating, CONFLICT_DATA schema compatibility, and cross-strategy --resume behavior.
**Why**: These tests gate all implementation stories — no implementation story may begin until these tests exist and are confirmed RED.
**Scope**:
- IN: Tests for merge-to-main.sh dispatch routing (direct→direct script, pr→pr script), enforcement.strategy hook short-circuit (HOOK_GATE: skipped log), structural hook always-on behavior (check-plugin-self-ref, check-portability, check-shim-refs, check-contract-schemas, check-referential-integrity always run regardless of strategy), enforcement.strategy=both idempotency (hook logic not double-executed), HOOK_GATE log line schema consistency across all gating hooks, CONFLICT_DATA schema equivalence between direct and PR modes, direct-mode regression (no network required), merge-to-main.sh --resume cross-strategy behavior (direct-mode state file rejected by PR-mode run)
- OUT: Implementation of the features under test; full E2E tests requiring live GitHub (those belong to S4)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, tests confirm merge-to-main.sh routes to merge-to-main-direct.sh when merge.strategy=direct and to merge-to-main-pr.sh when merge.strategy=pr
  <- Satisfies: "merge-to-main.sh becomes a thin dispatcher"
- When this story is complete, tests confirm enforcement.strategy=ci causes all gating PreToolUse hooks to short-circuit with HOOK_GATE: skipped reason=enforcement.strategy=ci log
  <- Satisfies: "PreToolUse hooks and .pre-commit-config.yaml entries read enforcement.strategy and short-circuit to no-op"
- When this story is complete, tests confirm structural integrity hooks (check-plugin-self-ref, check-portability, check-shim-refs, check-contract-schemas, check-referential-integrity) run regardless of enforcement.strategy value
  <- Satisfies: "no enforcement bypass"
- When this story is complete, tests confirm enforcement.strategy=both does NOT cause hook logic to run twice
  <- Satisfies: "enforcement.strategy (local|ci|both, default local) introduced"
- When this story is complete, tests confirm HOOK_GATE log line schema is identical across all gating hooks
  <- Satisfies: "HOOK_GATE: skipped reason=enforcement.strategy=ci log"
- When this story is complete, tests confirm CONFLICT_DATA output schema is identical between direct and PR modes
  <- Satisfies: "merge-to-main-direct.sh and merge-to-main-pr.sh both emit CONFLICT_DATA output with the same schema"
- When this story is complete, tests confirm direct-mode regression: merge-to-main.sh with merge.strategy=direct behaves identically to pre-epic baseline on a project with no GitHub remote
  <- Satisfies: "Direct-mode regression"
- When this story is complete, tests confirm merge-to-main.sh --resume rejects a direct-mode state file when current merge.strategy=pr with a clear error
  <- Satisfies: "merge-to-main.sh becomes a thin dispatcher"
- When this story is complete, all tests are run and confirmed failing (RED) before any implementation story begins; the failing run result is recorded in a story note
- When this story is complete, unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- [Testing] Mock-compatible interface required for GitHub API calls; direct-mode regression test must not require network
- [Testing] Structural-vs-correctness hook distinction must be explicitly documented in tests

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
